description: Non-investable supply-chain nodes (private companies + foreign-only listings excluded from the registry). Rendered as small grey circles in the viewer so the structural map is complete even where the entity isn't publicly tradable.

SK_HYNIX.name: SK Hynix Inc
SK_HYNIX.role: #2 DRAM globally, #1 HBM supplier to NVDA. Tightest single bottleneck in the AI GPU supply chain alongside TSM. Combined with Samsung (SSNLF) and Micron (MU) makes the global memory triopoly.

TOKYO_ELECTRON.name: Tokyo Electron Ltd
TOKYO_ELECTRON.role: #3 WFE globally. Strong in etch, deposition, coater/developer. OTC TOELY exists but illiquid / unsponsored — excluded from registry.

DISCO_CORP.name: Disco Corp
DISCO_CORP.role: Near-monopoly in precision wafer dicing + grinding equipment for advanced packaging (CoWoS, HBM stacking).

ZEISS_SMT.name: Carl Zeiss SMT GmbH
ZEISS_SMT.where: Subsidiary of Carl Zeiss AG (private foundation-owned)
ZEISS_SMT.role: Sole supplier of EUV optics modules to ASML. No public equity exposure. Without Zeiss, no EUV scanner ships.

TRUMPF.name: TRUMPF Group
TRUMPF.role: Sole supplier of CO2 seed laser source to ASML for EUV. Amplification done by Coherent (COHR).

JSR_CORP.name: JSR Corporation
JSR_CORP.role: Largest photoresist supplier globally; critical for EUV lithography. Was TSE-listed; taken private 2024.

OPENAI.name: OpenAI
OPENAI.where: US private (MSFT major investor + Stargate $500B partner with ORCL)
OPENAI.role: GPT-4/5/o series + ChatGPT + agents. Largest single buyer of NVDA AI compute through MSFT Azure + ORCL OCI relationships.

leadership.name: Sam Altman
leadership.note: co-founder; briefly ousted then reinstated Nov 2023

leadership.name: Greg Brockman
leadership.note: returned after the Nov 2023 board crisis

leadership.name: Jakub Pachocki
leadership.note: successor to Ilya Sutskever who left May 2024

leadership.name: Mira Murati
leadership.note: left Sep 2024 to start Thinking Machines

XAI.name: xAI Corp
XAI.role: Grok models. Colossus cluster in Memphis = ~200K H100 + B200 GPUs delivered by SMCI/DELL; largest single AI buildout outside hyperscalers.

ANTHROPIC.name: Anthropic PBC
ANTHROPIC.role: Claude models. Trains predominantly on AMZN Trainium (custom MRVL silicon) + NVDA. AMZN committed ~$8B; GOOGL ~$2B.

GROQ.name: Groq Inc
GROQ.where: US private (recent funding rounds at $2-3B valuation)
GROQ.role: LPU inference silicon — extremely fast token throughput; not competitive on training but disruptive on inference latency.

CEREBRAS.name: Cerebras Systems
CEREBRAS.where: US private (IPO filed Sep 2024, on hold)
CEREBRAS.role: Wafer-scale chip (CS-3) for AI training/inference. Targeted to challenge NVDA at very large model scale.

BLUEFORS.name: BlueFors Oy
BLUEFORS.role: Dominant dilution-refrigerator supplier for superconducting + trapped-ion quantum computers. Every IBM/GOOG/Rigetti/IonQ system has BlueFors hardware.

SK_HYNIX->NVDA.what_flows: HBM3E + HBM4 — #1 supplier to NVDA, ahead of MU and Samsung
SK_HYNIX->NVDA.trend: Growing fast; SK Hynix qualified HBM4 ahead of competitors

TOKYO_ELECTRON->TSM.what_flows: Coater/developer track tools + etch + deposition — TEL is TSM's #4 WFE vendor after ASML/AMAT/LRCX

DISCO_CORP->ASX.what_flows: Wafer dicing + grinding tools for OSAT advanced packaging

ZEISS_SMT->ASML.what_flows: EUV optics modules — every ASML EUV scanner contains Zeiss SMT optics
ZEISS_SMT->ASML.trend: Growing with high-NA EUV (more complex optics, higher unit price)

TRUMPF->ASML.what_flows: CO2 seed laser source for EUV light source

JSR_CORP->TSM.alternatives: TOK (Tokyo Ohka, TSE only), Shin-Etsu (SHECY OTC)

NVDA->OPENAI.what_flows: Indirect via MSFT Azure clusters — OpenAI's primary training + inference capacity is NVDA-on-Azure. Plus emerging direct via ORCL OCI Stargate buildout.
NVDA->OPENAI.key_event: Stargate $500B AI infra partnership Jan 2025 with ORCL + softbank + others

NVDA->XAI.what_flows: H100/H200/B200 GPUs for Colossus cluster in Memphis (~200K GPUs and growing)
NVDA->XAI.trend: Growing fast — xAI announced 1M-GPU cluster ambition

NVDA->ANTHROPIC.what_flows: NVDA GPUs via AWS Bedrock + GCP capacity (alongside Trainium)

SMCI->XAI.what_flows: Built-to-order GPU server racks for Colossus — SMCI was xAI's primary server vendor for the initial Memphis buildout
SMCI->XAI.deal_basis: xAI was disclosed as a major SMCI customer in FY25 commentary, alongside CoreWeave and hyperscalers.
SMCI->XAI.trend: Mixed — DELL competed for xAI Colossus 2 racks in 2025

DELL->XAI.what_flows: PowerEdge GPU racks for Colossus 2 expansion

MSFT->OPENAI.what_flows: $13B equity investment + Azure compute commitment. MSFT is OpenAI's largest customer/investor/compute provider.
MSFT->OPENAI.key_event: Restructured deal Sep 2025 reduced MSFT's exclusive-cloud claim for OpenAI

AMZN->ANTHROPIC.what_flows: ~$8B total investment across two rounds + Anthropic uses AWS Trainium for training

GOOGL->ANTHROPIC.what_flows: ~$2B investment + GCP TPU capacity for some Anthropic workloads

ORCL->OPENAI.what_flows: Stargate compute commitment — multi-year OCI GPU capacity
ORCL->OPENAI.deal_basis: ORCL-OpenAI Stargate partnership Sep 2025; $30B compute commitment over 5yr.
ORCL->OPENAI.key_event: Sep 2025 deal announcement triggered ORCL re-rating

COHR->BLUEFORS.what_flows: Specialty optics + lasers for quantum cryostat experiments

BLUEFORS->IONQ.what_flows: Dilution refrigerators for trapped-ion quantum systems

BLUEFORS->IBM.what_flows: Dilution refrigerators for IBM Quantum Heron + Condor + future systems

NVDA->GROQ.what_flows: GPUs for Groq's R&D + comparison benchmarking (Groq's primary value-prop is non-GPU LPU)
